_metadata.description: Professional operator UI and CLI surfaces.

requirements.title: Operator dashboard summarizes provider health, routing, and conformance debt
requirements.description: The UI must replace the generated placeholder with an operational dashboard that makes provider readiness, recent route outcomes, policy gaps, and conformance findings scannable.

validation.notes: Validates the operator dashboard renders provider, evidence, and conformance panels.
Validates the route preview operator workflow and result region.
Validates provider inventory and smoke controls in the operator UI.
Validates conformance scan controls and results in the operator UI.
BAS workflow proves the dashboard renders as the first operator screen.
BAS workflow proves route preview controls and result region render in the live UI.

requirements.title: Operators can inspect breaker, capacity, fallback, and route metrics across API/CLI/UI
requirements.description: An operator must be able to see why a provider was suppressed (open breaker), why a local route was skipped (capacity verdict), what fallback occurred, and what route metrics say — from API, CLI, and UI without reading logs or database rows. The API exposes ListProviderHealth and MeasuresService; the CLI exposes `routing health` and the `measures` group; the UI renders breaker/capacity verdicts on route preview candidates.

validation.notes: ListProviderHealth returns persisted breaker state with the effective state computed at read time.
Route preview health column renders breaker and capacity verdicts.
CLI measures group covers every MeasuresService RPC; `routing health` is covered by the routing manifest coverage test.

requirements.title: CLI supports policy inspection, route preview, smoke tests, and conformance scans
requirements.description: The CLI must expose scriptable commands for the same operator tasks as the UI, with JSON output suitable for agents and test-genie integration.

validation.notes: Validates generated CLI manifest coverage for gateway operations.
Validates generated CLI manifest coverage for inventory operations.
Validates generated CLI manifest coverage for routing operations.
Validates generated CLI manifest coverage for conformance operations.
